name: twitch-overlay-server
description: Serveur pour overlay Twitch avec EventSub et statistiques en temps réel

scripts.package:streamdeck: cd streamdeck-plugin && npm run build && npx streamdeck pack com.electrumvtc.overlay.streamdeck.sdPlugin --output ../dist --force
scripts.publish:win: electron-builder --win --publish always && npm run package:streamdeck && node scripts/upload-streamdeck-asset.js
scripts.clean: node -e "const EventSubManager = require('./src/services/EventSubManager'); const TwitchAuth = require('./src/services/TwitchAuth'); new EventSubManager(new TwitchAuth()).cleanupSubscriptions()"
